sanskrit: citiḥ svatantrā viśvasiddhihetuḥ || 1 || svecchayā svabhittau viśvam unmīlayati || 2 || tan nānā anurūpagrāhyagrāhakabhedāt || 3 || citisaṃkocātmā cetano 'pi saṃkucitaviśvamayaḥ || 4 ||

sanskrit:
citir eva cetanapadād avarūḍhā cetyasaṃkocinī
cittam || 5 || tanmayo māyāpramātā || 6 || sa caiko dvirūpas trimayaś caturātmā
saptapañcakasvabhāvaḥ || 7 || tadbhūmikāḥ sarvadarśanasthitayaḥ || 8 ||
source_edition: GRETIL [4-sūtra full spans, sha-verified vs volumes/phrdaya.json]

sanskrit:
cidvat tac chaktisaṃkocāt malāvṛtaḥ saṃsārī || 9 || tathāpi tadvat pañcakṛtyāni karoti || 10 || ābhāsanaraktivimarśanabījāvasthāpanavilāpanatas
tāni || 11 || tadaparijñāne svaśaktibhir vyāmohitatā
saṃsāritvam || 12 ||

sanskrit:
tatparijñāne cittam eva antarmukhībhāvena
cetanapadādhyārohāt citiḥ || 13 || citivahnir arohapade channo 'pi mātrayā
meyendhanaṃ pluṣyati || 14 || balalābhe viśvam ātmasātkaroti || 15 || cidānandalābhe dehādiṣu cetyamāneṣv api
cidaikātmyapratipattidārḍhyaṃ jīvanmuktiḥ || 16 ||

sanskrit:
madhyavikāsāc cidānandalābhaḥ || 17 || vikalpakṣayaśaktisaṃkocavikāsavāhacchedādyantakoṭinibhālanādaya
iha upāyāḥ || 18 || samādhisaṃskāravati vyutthāne bhūyo bhūyaḥ
cidaikyāmarśān nityoditasamādhilābhaḥ || 19 || sarvasargasaṃhārakārinijasaṃviddevatācakreśvaratāpraptir
bhavatīti śivam || 20 ||
